about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Dusty Johnson

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: FAREWELL TO CONGRESS
statements.title: FAREWELL TO CONGRESS
sentences: Mr. Speaker, there is still much to be done in the 119th Congress, and I promise I will keep working hard for South Dakota until the very end, but when this chapter of my life closes in January, I will not miss the shutdowns, the political posturing, or the TV cameras.
I will miss the people, the very best people. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROPOSING AN AMENDMENT TO THE CONSTITUTION OF THE UNITED STATES TO REQUIRE THAT THE SUPREME COURT OF THE UNITED STATES BE COMPOSED OF NINE JUSTICES
statements.title: PROPOSING AN AMENDMENT TO THE CONSTITUTION OF THE UNITED STATES TO REQUIRE THAT THE SUPREME COURT OF THE UNITED STATES BE COMPOSED OF NINE JUSTICES
sentences: Mr. Speaker, today's debate has convinced me more than ever that we need to cap the number of Supreme Court Justices at nine.
Seemingly no norm is safe, and indeed prominent leaders on the other side of the aisle have promised us that they will pack the Court with four more Supreme Court Justices when they regain power.
Now, the size of the Supreme Court should not be an arms race.
You can see Venezuela increasing their court to an eye-watering 32 justices in the pursuit of political power.
For 150 years, nine Supreme Court Justices have served us well.
Actually, Supreme Court Justices support nine as the number.
That is the Goldilocks spot, and it is not just conservative Justices who say it.

Today, we have an opportunity, Mr. Speaker, to heed those bipartisan calls, to remove a weapon in the hands of partisans, to defend and to protect a longstanding judicial norm, and to place the number of Supreme Court Justices as nine in our Constitution.
Mr. Speaker, I support the measure before us today.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: FEDERAL MARITIME COMMISSION REAUTHORIZATION ACT OF 2025
statements.title: FEDERAL MARITIME COMMISSION REAUTHORIZATION ACT OF 2025
sentences: Mr. Speaker, the Chinese Communist Party does not play fair.
Because the Chinese Communist Party doesn't play fair, we need a focused and effective cop on the beat.
We need someone who will be focused on the anticompetitive behavior from the Chinese Communist Party and others.

Secondly, it also provides the new authorities and direction that the FMC needs to be a vigilant protector for our American shippers so they can be a more informed regulator and a more effective guardian against the abuses by the Chinese Communist Party and their partners.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ENHANCING SCIENCE, TREATMENT, AND UPKEEP OF AMERICA'S RESILIENT AND IMPORTANT ESTUARINE SYSTEMS ACT
statements.title: ENHANCING SCIENCE, TREATMENT, AND UPKEEP OF AMERICA'S RESILIENT AND IMPORTANT ESTUARINE SYSTEMS ACT
sentences: I commend my colleagues on both sides of the aisle, particularly the diligent and hardworking Mr. Figures, as lead sponsor, for their work on this bill, and I urge support.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: EPERMIT ACT
statements.title: EPERMIT ACT
sentences: I was involved when Congress recognized the importance of these digital solutions in the Fiscal Responsibility Act of 2023.
Mr. Speaker, I will admit to being pretty excited that the ePermit Act is on the floor today, not just because it is my bill but because America needs this.

Because of this bill, we will modernize and digitize our permitting process with uniform data standards and a unified permitting portal so that agencies can work together and so that the public and communities can see what is actually happening.
I urge my colleagues to join us in letting America build again.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DIGITAL ASSET MARKET CLARITY ACT OF 2025
statements.title: DIGITAL ASSET MARKET CLARITY ACT OF 2025
sentences: That is certainly true for digital assets, NFTs, and memecoins.
Here is what matters: Blockchain technology, Web3, will transform every single industry in the same way that the internet has transformed every single industry over the last 30 years.
This is not about buying bubble gum with bitcoin.

This is about blockchain innovation happening here rather than overseas, about more liquid capital markets, about small businesses creating new services and products, about removing friction from transactions for every single American, and about protecting consumers so the debacles like the FTX meltdown never happen again.
The regulatory certainty provided by this incredible bipartisan work product will launch a golden age of innovation and the golden age of digital assets.
